items.title: 新版移动式空调器国家标准发布
items.summary: 中新网11月16日电 据“市说新语”微信公众号消息，移动式空调器凭借可移位、即插即用等特点，应用场景丰富，市场规模稳步扩张。近日，市场监管总局(国家标准委)修订发布《移动式空调器》(GB/T 22257—2026)国家标准。该标准明确移动式空调器的性能与质量相关要求，将有力促进行业技术升级，持续改善消费者使用体验。
items.titleEn: New version of the national standard for mobile air conditioners released
items.summaryEn: According to the Xinhua News Agency, mobile air conditioners with features such as portability, plug-in and instantaneous use, are rich in application scenarios, and the market size is steadily expanding. Recently, the National Standards Commission (NCC) has revised the national standard for the release of mobile air conditioning units (GB/T 22257 ton 2026). The standard clarifies the performance and quality requirements of mobile air conditioners, which will contribute to the upgrading of industry technology and the continuous improvement of consumer experience.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
